title: Joey Porter Jr. says he felt 'disrespected' and 'undervalued' by Steelers, wants to finish his career with Cowboys

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Joey Porter Jr. says he felt 'disrespected' and 'undervalued' by Steelers, wants to finish his career with Cowboys
sources.description: The fourth-year cornerback was traded to Dallas on Wednesday after missing all of training camp, the preseason and first three games of the season with a back injury.
